warnings: RESOLVES the T1 member sizes left null on หน้า16 (S-03): จันทัน (rafter) = C 150x75x9x12.5 มม., web ties = L 70x70x6 มม., purlins = C100x50x20x3.2 @1.00 ม., supporting column = WF 400x200x8x13 มม. (the CX mark). Roof slope is 25 degrees.

RESOLVES the missing 'แบบขยาย (ก)' flagged on หน้า19 (S-06). It is on THIS sheet, not S-06: a column-splice detail joining the WF400x200 column head to the roof frame through a 9 mm plate (0.20x0.40 m) and a 6 mm plate (0.20x0.35 m) with 4-ø12 bolts, welded all round. That is what S-03's two 'รอยต่อเสา ดูแบบขยาย (ก)' callouts point to.

T1's SPAN IS NOT DIMENSIONED. Every horizontal dimension on the T1 elevation reads 'ระยะตามแบบสถาปัตย์' (per the architectural drawings) instead of a number -- half-span, half-span and overall are all deferred. span_length_m is therefore null with span_source 'unresolved'; the 7.20 m ค-ก grid spacing is NOT stated here to be the truss span and was not assumed.

The two vertical dimensions (~1.65 and 0.60) are the only numeric heights given, and 1.65 is explicitly marked approximate ('~') on the sheet -- transcribed with that qualifier rather than as an exact value.

L-section members are recorded with leg1_mm/leg2_mm/t_mm rather than the d/b/tw/tf keys of §6a. The spec (§12) lists 'L' as a family whose key mapping is unverified; this is the first real L-section in the corpus and the key names are this file's proposal, not an established convention.

Bolt COUNTS are missing from จุดต่อ 3 and จุดต่อ 4 -- the sheet prints 'BOLT ø20 มม. พร้อมเกลียว' with no quantity at those joints, so count is omitted and flagged rather than inferred from how many bolt symbols appear on the drawing.
